response.talkTitle: Tracing at Scale: Running a 16 Billion Spans/Hour Pipeline at Nubank
response.note: Nubank runs 16B spans an hour through a Collector fleet. Load-balancing exporter by trace id, then tail sampling on errors and slow spans.
takeaways: Shard the Collector by trace id before tail sampling
Keep 100% of error traces, sample the rest
Budget memory per Collector pod and alert on refused spans

response.talkTitle: So You Want to Build a Platform? You Probably Already Have One
response.note: Most teams already run a platform: CI templates, a Helm library chart, a wiki page. Name it, give it an owner and a product backlog before buying a portal.
takeaways: Inventory the paved roads you already have
Treat the platform as a product with users
Measure lead time for a new service, not portal clicks
